sources.overlap_strategy: Merge all recent source observations by reservoir and source date on every run.

sources.overlap_strategy: Read the visible recent table and merge source dates; manual date inputs support recovery.
sources.schedule_rationale: 10:20 JST runs after the expected daily update while the approximately 30-day recent table supplies recovery margin.

sources.overlap_strategy: Archive timestamped raw API responses and idempotently merge each local observation date.
sources.schedule_rationale: 10:00 and 22:00 Malaysia time capture morning and evening states with one-run failure tolerance.
sources.licence_gate: Public commit remains subject to the LUAS terms and recorded reuse status.

sources.overlap_strategy: Archive every dated PDF with checksum and parse by the report's printed date.
sources.schedule_rationale: Two daytime UTC runs capture a stable-URL daily PDF before it can be replaced.
sources.licence_gate: Public commit is limited by the source-specific ABHSM reuse assessment.

sources.overlap_strategy: Re-fetch today and yesterday and merge by reservoir and observation date.

sources.overlap_strategy: Re-check the recent official weekly report range and retain downloaded reports by report date.

sources.overlap_strategy: Re-fetch yesterday and today, archive raw responses, and merge by reservoir and date.

sources.overlap_strategy: Fetch the full available five-day 15-minute window and recompute only complete local days idempotently.
sources.schedule_rationale: Twice-daily capture leaves substantial recovery margin inside the approximately five-day source window.
sources.licence_gate: AGE CC0 evidence applies to the operational open-data resource; preserve the source evidence and do not extend it to requested long archives.

sources.overlap_strategy: Fetch every currently listed bulletin, deduplicate by report date and checksum, and retry Wayback recovery separately.
sources.schedule_rationale: Twice-daily capture protects the observed approximately eight-issue rolling bulletin window.
sources.licence_gate: Reuse terms are undeclared_review; do not publish bulletin contents in the public repository until redistribution permission is resolved.

sources.overlap_strategy: Archive each accessible current per-dam snapshot by source date and merge without replacing the historical XLSX archive.
sources.schedule_rationale: Proposed morning and evening Istanbul runs; deployment waits for a stable non-protected endpoint or approved runner.
sources.licence_gate: Open-attribution evidence must be confirmed for the current endpoint before public snapshot commits.

sources.overlap_strategy: Re-fetch the full ~30-day observed window on every run and merge by gauge and validTime; identical timestamps are overwritten with the latest value.
sources.schedule_rationale: NWPS retains about 30 days of observed pool elevations for TVA dams, so three captures a day give a very large recovery margin against GitHub cron delay and transient NWPS outages. TVA publishes no public API and tva.com blocks automated clients, making this relay the only machine-readable observed route.
sources.licence_gate: BLOCKED for public redistribution. The NWS relay is U.S. public domain but the underlying TVA reuse terms could not be verified because tva.com refuses automated access; records carry licence_status=undeclared_review until a written TVA confirmation or a successful terms review is recorded.

sources.overlap_strategy: Merge by the page's own printed as-at date, never the fetch date; a repeated page simply rewrites equal values.
sources.schedule_rationale: The national table is refreshed roughly weekly on Mondays (UTC+2) and overwritten in place. Tuesday 08:10 local captures the fresh table; Friday recovers a missed Tuesday before the next overwrite.

sources.overlap_strategy: Probe the last 8 Monday-dated bulletin URLs each run and merge by the bulletin's printed date, so a resumed publication is picked up without duplication.
sources.schedule_rationale: Tuesday and Thursday 07:40 Africa/Windhoek. The site keeps only the latest bulletin PDF, so the Thursday run is the recovery attempt for a failed Tuesday within the same publication week. Publication has been frozen since 2024-07-08, so both runs double as a resumption watch.

sources.overlap_strategy: Merge the three overlapping trend arrays plus the spot value by date; the roughly one-year window gives ample recovery margin for missed runs.

sources.overlap_strategy: Merge by (printed dashboard date, reservoir). Each dashboard also prints the previous week's percentage, which is stored for its own date and is superseded by that week's own 'current' reading.
sources.schedule_rationale: 11:00 SAST Tuesday and Thursday. The City of Cape Town publishes one weekly dashboard at a stable URL that is overwritten, so a missed week cannot be recovered from the source; Thursday is the recovery attempt. Added 2026-08-04 because the national DWS bulletin stopped publishing after 2026-06-29 and every downstream mirror froze on that date.
